label: SmartArt Design (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'SmartArt Tools' family; exists only while: a SmartArt graphic is selected. Groups: Create Graphic, Layouts, SmartArt Styles, Reset. Appeared on the 'smartart' probe.

children.label: Add Shape
children.tooltip: Add a shape to the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Add Bullet
children.tooltip:
Add a text bullet to your SmartArt graphic.

This option is available only if the selected layout supports bulleted text.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, B; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Text Pane
children.tooltip:
Show or hide the Text Pane.

The Text Pane helps you to quickly input and organize the text in the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Promote
children.tooltip:
Increase the level of the selected bullet or shape.

This option is most useful when working with the Text Pane.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Demote
children.tooltip:
Decrease the level of the selected bullet or shape.

This option is most useful when working with the Text Pane.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, D; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Right to Left

icon.description: Right to Left control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Switch the layout of the SmartArt graphic between Left to Right and Right to Left.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Move Before
children.tooltip: Move the current selection to be earlier in the sequence.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, M; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Move After
children.tooltip: Move the current selection to be later in the sequence.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Layout
children.tooltip:
Change the branch layout for the selected shape.

This option is available only if you are using an organizational chart layout, found in the Hierarchy category.
children.state_notes: group 'Create Graphic'; keytip Alt, J S, G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: SmartArtLayoutGallery
children.tooltip: Change the layout applied to the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'Layouts'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Change Colors
children.tooltip: Change the color variation applied to the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'SmartArt Styles'; keytip Alt, J S, C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: SmartArtStylesGallery
children.tooltip: Choose an overall visual style for the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'SmartArt Styles'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Reset Graphic
children.tooltip: Discard all of the formatting changes made to the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'Reset'; keytip Alt, J S, E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)
